newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 26.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 26.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* Philippine president Fidel Ramos will check out of the hospital today after undergoing a surgery removing a cholesterol block in his right carotid artery.
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones rose 33.83 points to 6,522.85. PLDT's ADR rose by $2 1/4 to $53 7/8. The U.S. equities market was closed on December 25, Christmas Day.
* On Tuesday, the peso was firmer at 26.297 to the U.S. dollar from 26.300. The Philippine financial markets were closed on December 25.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,152.53, up 12.61
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate rose to 11.21875 pct from 11.125 pct.
